data.long_meaning: Aabida is a female name in Arabic, Urdu and Persian, meaning 'worshipper of God'. The name Aabida carries the meaning “Worshipper of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aabida usually hope their child will grow to embody worshipper of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Aabida signifies one who is devoted to Allah, a true servant, and someone who worships Him with sincerity and devotion.
data.etymology: Aabida belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Worshipper of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabida total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_urdu.name: عابدہ

in_hindi.name: आबिदा
